notes: This registry stores source repositories and PoC/template collections for authorized RedScope workflows.
Downloaded source material is reference material only. RedScope workflows must not execute PoC code directly from tools/sources.
Many public PoC repositories are untrusted and can contain malware, payloads, or destructive samples. Treat every download as quarantined review material.
All enabled sources use a seven-day update interval unless a source overrides updateIntervalDays.
Proxy node discovery is intentionally not included. Use only project-authorized egress configuration outside this registry.

sources.name: ProjectDiscovery Nuclei Templates
sources.redscopeUse: Curated nuclei templates for authorized template matching against explicitly scoped assets.
safetyNotes: Templates are not executed unless a separate authorized profile selects nuclei and confirms active execution.
Review high-risk templates before enabling active scans.

sources.name: Trickest CVE PoC Index
sources.redscopeUse: Reference index for CVE-to-PoC triage and coverage planning.
safetyNotes: Use for lookup and analyst review only.
Do not execute linked PoCs without a separate written run profile.

sources.name: PoC-in-GitHub
sources.redscopeUse: Broad GitHub PoC index for defensive coverage research and authorized exploitability triage.
safetyNotes: Upstream explicitly warns that collected repositories can contain malware.
Keep as quarantined metadata/reference material. Do not execute collected code from this tree.

sources.name: Vulhub
sources.redscopeUse: Reference vulnerable-lab environments for reproducing findings in isolated local labs.
safetyNotes: Do not start Docker Compose labs automatically.
Labs must run only in isolated, analyst-approved environments.

sources.name: Knownsec Pocsuite3
sources.redscopeUse: Reference PoC framework and plugin ecosystem for authorized validation planning.
safetyNotes: Framework code is reference-only unless a dedicated restricted run profile is written.
Never auto-run PoC modules from this source.

sources.name: Metasploit Framework
sources.redscopeUse: Optional framework/module reference for analyst review in mature authorized environments.
safetyNotes: Large source tree; not required for default RedScope workflows.
Do not execute modules from tools/sources.

sources.name: Chaitin Xray
sources.redscopeUse: Optional web PoC/template reference for analyst review.
safetyNotes: Not required for default RedScope workflows.
Scanner execution must be added as a separate authorized profile.
